title: OVIBench: Benchmarking Online Video Question Answering under Interruption
abstract: arXiv:2608.22279v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent vision language models (VLMs) have achieved strong progress in video understanding. However, most existing video QA research and benchmarks still follow an offline, single-round paradigm, overlooking realistic interactions where users may interrupt the model during answer generation. To address this gap, we formulate the task of Online Video Question Answering under Interruption and introduce OVIBench, the first standardized benchmark for evaluating VLMs in this setting. OVIBench categorizes interruptions into three types: Cancellation, False Trigger, Correction and supports both open-ended and multiple-choice evaluations. To enable large-scale and reproducible testing, we develop an offline simulation protocol that reproduces interruption during generation under a unified temporal setup, together with a multi-dimensional metric suite for assessing interruption understanding and response generation. translated_title: OVIBench：中断场景下的在线视频问答基准测试
translated_abstract: 摘要：近年来，视觉语言模型（VLMs）在视频理解方面取得了显著进展。然而，大多数现有的视频问答研究和基准仍遵循离线、单轮范式，忽略了用户可能在答案生成过程中中断模型的现实交互场景。为解决这一空白，我们提出了“中断场景下的在线视频问答”任务，并引入了OVIBench，这是首个用于评估VLMs在该场景下性能的标准化基准。OVIBench将中断分为三类：取消、误触发和纠正，并支持开放式和多项选择评估。为实现大规模可复现测试，我们开发了一种离线模拟协议，在统一时间设置下模拟生成过程中的中断，并配套了多维指标套件，用于评估中断理解和响应生成。实验表明，
tldr: 该论文首次提出并构建了OVIBench基准，专门用于评估视觉语言模型在用户中断场景下的在线视频问答能力，并设计了离线模拟协议和多维指标。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces OVIBench, the first standardized benchmark for evaluating vision-language models in online video question answering under user interruptions, with an offline simulation protocol and multi-dimensional metrics.
